ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels in the central lobe regions versus 35% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels along the trailing edges and medial region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary contiguous white zones occupy the distal-central areas of the left and right lobes. These are bordered by a solid black perimeter along the trailing edge and high-density black mottling that concentrates toward the median notch and bottom-central field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow, acute V-shaped notch with an approximate interior angle of 30-35 degrees and a vertical pixel depth of approximately 8% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitudes between 3 and 10 pixels; topography becomes significantly more jagged and non-uniform at the outer tips due to epibiotic presence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curve along the superior trailing edge, tapering toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast clusters of beige and dark pixels localized exclusively on the distal tips of both lobes, representing active barnacle colonies.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both lateral tips, significantly altering the trailing edge geometry at these points; no visible amputations or large-scale trauma marks.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct 'peppery' dark-intensity spotting scattered within the medial transition zones between the solid white fields and the central dark pigmentation.
